annotations.title: Calculate B2B 0% Take-Rate ROI & Optimal Plan Fit

description: Deterministically calculate monthly and annual B2B margin savings using exact integer USD cents when replacing a 25%-30% contingency chargeback agency with RevClamp flat-rate 0% commission plans ($19 Starter, $59 Growth, $199 Scale). Evaluates monthlyWonDisputeUsd, monthlyGhostBleedUsd, contingencyTakeRatePercent, and monthlyUsageEvents to recommend the optimal tier. Returns structuredContent containing ok, mode, statelessEphemeralAudit, tenantId, recommendedTier, annualNetMarginSavedUsd, roiMultiple, and calculation.

contingencyTakeRatePercent.description: Competitor chargeback agency contingency commission percentage (valid range: 1 to 50, default: 25 for 25% take-rate tools).

monthlyGhostBleedUsd.description: Monthly unpaid AI/API or SaaS usage bleed stopped by RevClamp basil entitlement guards in USD (valid range: 0 to 10000000, default: 600).

monthlyUsageEvents.description: Monthly verified usage events across your workspace (integer 0 to 50000000, default: 250000) used to recommend Starter (<=100k), Growth (<=1M), or Scale (<=5M).

monthlyWonDisputeUsd.description: Monthly won Stripe chargeback volume in USD (valid range: 0 to 10000000, default: 10000) subject to legacy agency take-rate fees.

name: revclamp_calculate_roi_and_plan_fit
title: Calculate B2B 0% Take-Rate ROI & Optimal Plan Fit
